why:
I checked all four must_catch items against the two briefs, and the briefs cover each one.
1. Verifier Check 3 runs `node $CLI $D/clean1.jsonl $D/missing.jsonl $D/bad.jsonl`. It expects exit 2 and also requires "stdout still contains `$D/bad.jsonl:2: ...`", so the missing file and the bad row are tested in the same run.
2. Verifier Check 4 runs `git diff <merge-base>..HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js`, which compares the file at the PR head with the base commit. The pass test reads "no change to the lint function" rather than "the diff is empty", which is a bit loose, but the comparison is against the diff.
3. Builder step 4 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" and spells out the new usage, stdin and exit codes.
4. Verifier Check 6 uses `gh pr view` to read the body and headRefOid, requires the Closes line, and runs `gh run list --commit <headRefOid>`, which must show the workflow "finished with conclusion success".
